title: Audi and Porsche EV drivers gain NACS adapters (electrive)
notes: Audi NACS DC adapter comes with new 2025 Q6 e-tron, A6 Sportback e-tron and e-tron GT; current owners do not yet have access to the adapter; quotes Audi: Q4 e-tron cannot currently use the adapter or the Tesla NACS Partner Supercharger network.
